Taproot#001.src: ...oh. {u}, you're back. Ehm...I have to say, I'm...rather busy at the moment.
Taproot#001.speaker: Lari

Taproot#002.src: I have...important things to do. This accursed Decay...I have to end it. This all needs to stop.
Taproot#002.speaker: Lari

Taproot#003.src: I am thankful for your aid with the...the Grootslang, but I do not believe you will be able to help with this- Simply a matter of scale.
Taproot#003.speaker: Lari

Taproot#004.src: I apologize, but I need to focus on my task here. If, perhaps, you could come back another time? And, I do mean that sincerely...
Taproot#004.speaker: Lari

Taproot#005.src: I can't even recall how many attempts this will make...but all my knowledge has gone into this. This must work.
Taproot#005.speaker: Lari

Taproot#006.src: Follow Lari to the black spot next to her camp.

Taproot#007.src: ...I suppose I can't fault you for being curious. You may have seen a large, dark-looking patch of ground on your way here- I am trying to tend to it once more.
Taproot#007.speaker: Lari

Taproot#008.src: It is...the most obvious stain of the decay, and very intense...if I can scrub this out, the rest should follow.
Taproot#008.speaker: Lari

Taproot#009.src: This concoction of mine should...do the trick!
Taproot#009.speaker: Lari

Taproot#010.src: It...it's working!! I can feel it, the land is reacting positively!
Taproot#010.speaker: Lari

Taproot#011.src: I...I... It was...it was working, a-and... Agh, why can't I get this RIGHT?!
Taproot#011.speaker: Lari

Taproot#012.src: How many decades have I been doing this? How much time have I wasted, just...flailing like this?!
Taproot#012.speaker: Lari

Taproot#013.src: Look, , I...I don't know what you expect to do against this. The Wyrm was one thing, but...this is beyond your comprehension.
Taproot#013.speaker: Lari

Taproot#014.src: I think you sh... Should...w-what is... Now, of all times? As I fail?!
Taproot#014.speaker: Lari

Taproot#015.src: The road, look! He's contacting me! A-are you finally giving me the answers I've asked for?
Taproot#015.speaker: Lari

Taproot#016.src: Follow the trail of magic leading from the black spot.

Taproot#017.src: Talk to Lari outside the weird gate at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Taproot#018.src: ...I followed you seeking answers...and here, I am presented with more questions. Why did he bring us here?
Taproot#018.speaker: Lari

Taproot#019.src: This gate has appeared, immovable and impassable, since the moment that...that everything started.
Taproot#019.speaker: Lari

Taproot#020.src: I don't...is he trying to remind me of what's at stake? Did he want to show y- No, that's...he wouldn't know you...but then, what IS this about?!
Taproot#020.speaker: Lari

Taproot#021.src: Rrgh... ANSWER ME! PLEASE! I've begged you for so long to answer!
Taproot#021.speaker: Lari

Taproot#022.src: You gave me my task and your light but never told me what to DO! I've tried everything I can think of!!
Taproot#022.speaker: Lari

Taproot#023.src: Tell me! Please, just t-tell me already!! I don't know how much longer I can stand this!!
Taproot#023.speaker: Lari

Taproot#024.src: I...a-another one? Where are you leading me now?
Taproot#024.speaker: Lari

Taproot#025.src: It...the gateway...? Are you...I can't understand! Why this, again?
Taproot#025.speaker: Lari

Taproot#026.src: You showed me this before... At first, when you first contacted me. I made the choice...
Taproot#026.speaker: Lari

Taproot#027.src: Must I make it again? Is that it, do I need to prove myself to you once more?
Taproot#027.speaker: Lari

Taproot#028.src: I...what? You...you present me with this, but refuse to let me do what you want?
Taproot#028.speaker: Lari

Taproot#029.src: ...please, can you investigate the doorway? There must be something wrong that I don't understand.
Taproot#029.speaker: Lari

Taproot#032.src: My pulse... Human. I must inquire to you. I present you a test. Guide your attention to those you see.

Taproot#033.src: I must see the rhythm your heart beats. Listen well.

Taproot#034.src: This has gone far enough. I can't do this anymore! I can't give you any more and I refuse to apologize for it!
Taproot#034.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#035.src: You know our deal. Remember what good you are doing by following the plans I've laid out for you.
Taproot#035.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#036.src: Are you going to let your emotions cloud your judgment? You're a smarter man than that, Mr. Mayor.
Taproot#036.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#037.src: You can't possibly believe that throwing away the lives of innocent people is right! I can't go on with this on my conscience!
Taproot#037.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#038.src: Detective Hart WILL be hearing from me, and he'll be hearing everything. We can't keep sacrificing our own like this!
Taproot#038.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#039.src: Our golems have single-handedly turned the tide of the Humans' corruption war. You would save ten here and sentence a thousand to die overseas?
Taproot#039.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#040.src: You're a sick, twisted man, Urelix. I will not abide by this a moment longer.
Taproot#040.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#041.src: My pulse, you must decide. Three paths diverge upon your road.

Taproot#042.src: You may leave. The rays of fate will see to destiny unfolding.

Taproot#043.src: You may end this Mayor's life. Blood upon your hands in many ways.

Taproot#044.src: You may end the life of Urelix. Heartbeats ceased by a bleeding heart.

Taproot#045.src: Which way does your heart beat? How will you cast your light? Can you see?

Taproot#047.src: My pulse... The blood of a bleeding heart has poisoned me. Even if you believe the sun should shine elsewhere, you must direct it yourself.

Taproot#048.src: You must realize what is needed. You must see light through my lens.

Taproot#049.src: To leave... As destiny unfolds, the sun shall set.

Taproot#050.src: To end this Mayor's life... To snuff out one whose heart aches is painful.

Taproot#051.src: To end the life of Urelix... The shadows of war shall engulf all.

Taproot#052.src: My pulse, there is only one choice. You must do what is required, I beg of you.

Taproot#053.src: Ah, you recognize necessity. That couldn't have been pleasant...but what's needed isn't pleasant, in the end.
Taproot#053.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#056.src: ...I didn't think you would be able to help, but I had to ask. So...was this for nothing?
Taproot#056.speaker: Lari

Taproot#057.src: Wait...y-you...had a choice? He gave you the choice too?! A-Already?!
Taproot#057.speaker: Lari

Taproot#058.src: Wh- I don't understand! You...you just arrived to Gavel! You haven't seen its decline! Felt its pain!
Taproot#058.speaker: Lari

Taproot#059.src: What did you do?! The gate is opening? YOU did this?! I know your heart is in the right place, but you're a stranger to this land!
Taproot#059.speaker: Lari

Taproot#060.src: I...I...rrrgh... AAAAGH!! This isn't fair!! I've worked for decades and the light just...throws me to the wayside?!
Taproot#060.speaker: Lari

Taproot#062.src: My pulse, you must leave her be. Her heart's emotions have overpowered her mind's judgement. She must learn to separate them as you have.

Taproot#063.src: Please... You can't DO this to me!!
Taproot#063.speaker: Lari

Taproot#064.src: Why do you want this human to enter the Taproot?! What's special about them, what's their connection? What have they done that I haven't?! Tell me, please! Let me be useful!!
Taproot#064.speaker: Lari

Taproot#067.src: Your heartbeat beats in time with mine. Your mind is unclouded, despite the fury you have been steeped in. My pulse, you are needed.

Taproot#068.src: Your eyes cannot see the scope of the realms. You must allow me to shed light upon them- You must see the connections.

Taproot#069.src: Light... Dark... We oppose. I am light. It is dark. Our places reflect this land...and it is plain- The sun is setting. Light is fading

Taproot#070.src: The land you visit warps with the slow siphoning of my light, my blood. It becomes outlandish and strange-Oppressive and alien.

Taproot#071.src: As dusk approaches- As darkness spreads- My heart slows and stops. My pulse, you are needed. You shall be as one with me, and you shall see.

Taproot#072.src: {p} needs life anew- A new pulse. It need you.

Taproot#074.src: Our light is synchronous! You may see what I must have you see...

Taproot#075.src: Follow the road. You must witness the reason behind my trial.

Taproot#076.src: See my memories. The memories of the realm. See...and be enlightened.

Taproot#077.src: Witness it... The Equinox. Learn why you are needed, my pulse.

Taproot#080.src: My light...I won't let you down!
Taproot#080.speaker: Lari

Taproot#082.src: Wah! Back away, I don't want to hurt you!
Taproot#082.speaker: Lari

Taproot#083.src: I can do this... Orphion, lend me your voice!
Taproot#083.speaker: Lari

Taproot#084.src: Return to your realm in peace!
Taproot#084.speaker: Lari

Taproot#085.src: Your power is blinded by light. You cannot win!
Taproot#085.speaker: Lari

Taproot#086.src: Peace, strange creature! You must be peaceful!
Taproot#086.speaker: Lari

Taproot#087.src: Why isn't this working? Even Orphion's voice...
Taproot#087.speaker: Lari

Taproot#088.src: It's scarring the land... I need to end this, quickly...
Taproot#088.speaker: Lari

Taproot#089.src: His light... This power... I can do this!
Taproot#089.speaker: Lari

Taproot#090.src: The embodiment of light supports me!
Taproot#090.speaker: Lari

Taproot#091.src: You cannot fight the focus of pure light!
Taproot#091.speaker: Lari

Taproot#092.src: Be done! I bind you with Orphion's light!
Taproot#092.speaker: Lari

Taproot#094.src: Lari... A conflicted heart failed to channel my light. She refused to battle.

Taproot#095.src: The vile intruder was weak... But every opportunity to strike, exchanged for words to the deaf.

Taproot#096.src: My pulse... it pains me. Her light simply fails to shine where it is needed, and so we are here.

Taproot#097.src: Talk to Lari outside the Taproot gate.

Taproot#098.src: I... I...hope you'll forgive me, {u}. My anger wasn't with you. I...j-just...
Taproot#098.speaker: Lari

Taproot#099.src: I work for untold years, trying to save this province, to save a Realm... All to so little avail. To the sound of silence from the one I'm trying to help.
Taproot#099.speaker: Lari

Taproot#100.src: And then, you appear, and... I still haven't ever been in there. I'd...I'd ask what it was like, but it's...probably private, right?
Taproot#100.speaker: Lari

Taproot#101.src: At...at least I have an ally now, r-right? But...I'm afraid that... N-no, it's silly, you don't need to hear me fretting.
Taproot#101.speaker: Lari

Taproot#102.src: I... I promise I can still be useful. I'll... I'll find a way. I promise you. I'll...get out of your way, for now.
Taproot#102.speaker: Lari
